fieldValues.title: Phase 1 scope
fieldValues.decision_question: Should Phase 1 cover the full stairwell including the main hallway, or just the back stairs and landings?
fieldValues.context: The back stairs have a large amount of wall space across multiple landings. The main hallway was also discussed as a potential exhibition space, but adding it in Phase 1 would significantly increase the scope of the first experiment.
fieldValues.friction: Taking on too much in Phase 1 risks overextending the group's capacity before the mounting system and workflow have been tested.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: Including the main hallway in Phase 1. Deferred to Phase 2.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Phase 1 covers the back stairs and landings only. The main hallway is explicitly deferred to Phase 2, contingent on Phase 1 working well.
fieldValues.rationale: Starting smaller allows the group to test the mounting system, workflow, and artist relations before expanding. The main hallway is more visible and involves more parties.
fieldValues.revisit_when: December 2026 pilot review — if Phase 1 is working, bring main hallway into scope for Phase 2.
